verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows AI-assisted documentation search and llms.txt/llms-full.txt files that help AI tools index Paxos docs (paxos-docs-18, paxos-docs-30, paxos-docs-31) — these aid developers finding docs, not natural-language operation of the Paxos platform itself. There is no evidence of a chat/agent interface, NL command parser, or any mechanism to execute Paxos operations (transfers, trades, identity checks) via natural-language commands.
